integrity: Symbolic proof, two independently designed standalone finite verifiers, recorded outputs. Published related sources were compared at the level of claims and signatures; independent mathematical audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Equivalence is relative to the class of finite products of two nonempty chains, in the single reflexive order signature. It is not a characterization among all finite posets; no generalization to three or more factors or sharp quantifier-depth bound is claimed. Finite programs corroborate but do not prove the infinite theorem. Historical priority is qualified.
title: Two-variable logical rigidity of finite rectangular distributive lattices
